name: Spoon
description: The household shopping list and recipe book.
_comment_display: standalone. Fullscreen was tried in v9.2 to escape the system bars entirely and was worse: Android left a black band where the status bar had been, cutout and all, and hid the gesture bar. Reverted in v9.3.
_comment_colours: theme_color is deliberately ABSENT. With it set, Chrome bakes that one colour into the WebAPK at install and the status bar ignores <meta name=theme-color> forever after - proven across three builds: #f4f7fd gave a light bar, #16181d gave a black one, in every app theme. Removing it leaves Chrome nothing to bake, so the live meta - which app.js keeps in step with the resolved --bg - is the only colour on offer. background_color stays: it only tints the launch splash, and dark suits both phones.
